data.name: Module.Description
data.value: Provides protected local or remote status, device pairing, and EventBus activity streams for NCF desktop clients.

data.name: Page.PairingInfo.Description
data.value: When the desktop token is left blank, a pairing code valid for 5 minutes is generated. Verify the pairing code and source address before approving it. Session tokens are valid for 24 hours, are never displayed in Admin, and can be revoked at any time.

data.name: Page.EmptyPending
data.value: There are no pairing requests awaiting approval.

data.name: Page.EmptySessions
data.value: There are no active sessions issued through pairing.

data.name: Page.LegacyTokenNotice
data.value: Environment-variable tokens are a compatibility channel. They do not appear in the active sessions list and cannot be revoked from this page.

data.name: Message.Approve.Success
data.value: Pairing approved. The session token will be delivered only to the desktop client that initiated the request.

data.name: Message.Approve.Failed
data.value: The pairing request has expired, was already handled, or the active-session limit has been reached.

data.name: Message.Deny.Failed
data.value: The pairing request has expired or was already handled.

data.name: Message.Revoke.Success
data.value: The session was revoked. The desktop client was notified, will leave the current site state, and will remain open.

data.name: Message.Revoke.Failed
data.value: The session does not exist or is no longer valid.

data.name: Auth.Description
data.value: After confirmation, the current GUI will use AdminChat as this administrator. Only a one-time authorization result is transferred; browser cookies are never read or copied.

data.name: Auth.Warning
data.value: Continue only if the NCF GUI you are using opened this page automatically.

data.name: Auth.Error.RequestExpired
data.value: The desktop authorization request does not exist or has expired. Return to the GUI and try again.

data.name: Auth.Error.LoginExpired
data.value: The WebView administrator session has expired. Sign in again.

data.name: Auth.Error.MultiTenantDenied
data.value: Automatic WebView authorization is not currently supported for tenant administrators. Use explicit sign-in.

data.name: Auth.Error.MultiTenantRetry
data.value: Automatic WebView authorization is not currently supported for tenant administrators. Return to the GUI and use explicit sign-in.

data.name: Auth.Error.LoginExpiring
data.value: The WebView administrator session is about to expire. Sign in again.

data.name: Auth.Error.RequestInvalid
data.value: The desktop authorization request is no longer valid. Return to the GUI and try again.

data.name: NeuBell.Empty
data.value: There are no device pairing requests awaiting review.

data.name: Pairing.Expired
data.value: The pairing request has expired. Start a new request.

data.name: Pairing.Denied
data.value: An administrator denied this pairing request.

data.name: Pairing.RateLimit.Message
data.value: Too many pairing requests. Try again later.

data.name: Pairing.Invalid.Detail
data.value: The pairing request does not exist or the retrieval credentials are incorrect.

data.name: Pairing.Transport.Title
data.value: DesktopBridge pairing requires a secure connection

data.name: Pairing.Transport.Detail
data.value: Remote pairing requires HTTPS. HTTP is allowed only for localhost or a local SSH tunnel.

data.name: Auth.Error.WebViewDenied
data.value: The WebView session cannot be used for desktop authorization.

data.name: Auth.Error.RateLimit.Message
data.value: Too many desktop authorization requests. Try again later.

data.name: Auth.Error.Invalid.Detail
data.value: Start the WebView administrator authorization again.

data.name: Auth.Error.OneTimeExpired
data.value: The one-time authorization is invalid or has expired.

data.name: Auth.Error.AdministratorDenied
data.value: This administrator identity cannot be used for desktop authorization.

data.name: Auth.Transport.Title
data.value: Desktop authorization requires a secure connection

data.name: Auth.Transport.Detail
data.value: Remote token exchange requires HTTPS. HTTP is allowed only for localhost or a local SSH tunnel.
